text: Slice 11 plan: a driver can't skip a step (PRD 3.11). Six projects here have a TypeScript or Python driver, and nothing checks that a driver tried every step, only the synthesis prompt's instruction since copythis-ad#33 (D-0059). The gate would record every attempt and ask TLC which steps only a bound rules out in each state the driver reached, so a driver never names its own excuse to skip, and a capacity the code enforces counts as a rule. A second agent reviews every driver: all of one that samples, and the sizes one that explores calls the code's parameters. Existing drivers are rebuilt through amendments that change no statement. @gitdek ratified it with all five recommendations: it comes before the Codex backend, both checks apply, existing drivers are rebuilt now, Go's explorers follow in this slice if it fits, and the second agent's review checks the parameters the manifest names.
